zoning_rules: The CF district permits childcare centers and limits lot coverage to 40%. In the Creek Corridor Overlay, development must preserve an undisturbed vegetated buffer at least 10 meters wide from the top of the creek bank. A proposal for a parcel adjoining the creek must show the surveyed bank line and the buffer dimensions before compliance with this requirement can be determined. If total impervious surface exceeds 50% of the parcel, an infiltration plan is also required.
